gating_model.client_scope: The client patch is FIXED per flavor. Only world CONTENT is gated — never the binary, DBCs, maps, vmaps, mmaps, or the client's own UI (design §0). Default = the flavor's final patch, so existing worlds are unaffected.
gating_model.seed: One pinned seed per flavor (the flavor's final-patch state, protected by the sqlite-seed-baseline hash chain). Per-stage seeds are rejected; the stage delta is a reversible flag-set layer over the seeded datadir.
gating_model.mechanism: game_event active windows + availability flags: per-stage reversible overlay SQL (flag-set statements only, never DELETE) over the world DB, plus stage-marker game_event rows whose CONDITION_ACTIVE_GAME_EVENT conditions demote vendor/loot/quest/entry rows — every mechanism shares one activation story (design §2/§3). Applied at world start when the active stage differs from the applied one.
gating_model.status: v1 = the gating framework (stage registry, settings knobs, conf emission, era-policy linkage) with EMPTY measured id sets; curated per-stage sets land only with the measured DB pins (design §9.2), never before.

final_stage_era_baseline.source: W3.1 corpus-driven curation (port plan S3.4; probe 2026-10-11 against the shipped WoTLKDB_1_9 dump): the WotLK lane LEGITIMIZES everything through WotLK — Northrend, floating Dalaran, Acherus, the Ebon Blade, the expansion title, flying mounts and every vanilla-banned TBC concept (all corpus-proven WotLK vocabulary) — and bans Cataclysm+ concepts instead (the playable-worgen/Gilneas reveal, the Cata+ zones and expansion titles). Round-1 R5-1: n'zoth was REMOVED from the always-ban list — the shipped shared lore corpus names N'Zoth in vanilla-era lore cards (Naga, Old God), so banning it dropped real cards on this lane (a live false ban). Deathwing/Neltharion/cataclysm-lore vocabulary is deliberately NOT banned: the WotLK dump itself serves that lore (192/49/179 whole-word hits — WotLK-era Twilight's Hammer content discusses the coming Cataclysm), so banning it would be a live false ban.
final_stage_era_baseline.never_ban_discipline: Context-allow words (outland, dalaran, lich king, northrend, naxxramas, kel'thuzad, blood elf, wrath, legion, death knight, worgen, cataclysm, deathwing, ...) collide with WotLK-legitimate vocabulary and are NEVER banned; only full later-era senses are. The mists-of-pandaria/nazjatar guards hit the shipped WotLK dump (1/8 whole-word lore mentions) and are deliberate anachronism guards recorded in tests/test_timeframes_era_flavors.py (KEPT_GUARDS_WOTLK).

gatefix_note: Code-red round 1 (R5-1/R5-2): n'zoth removed from always_ban (lore-corpus false ban); the Cata+ zone guards added per the dump scan (deepholm 32, kezan 35, tol barad 25, twilight highlands 14, wandering isle 17, gilneas city 7, lost isles 5, stonecore 2 whole-word hits in the shipped WotLK dump — live Cata+ text anachronisms, now guarded). Round 2 (R2-2): the Cata guard set extended (+8: vortex pinnacle 88, firelands 33, bilgewater 40, therazane 20, ramkahen 9, throne of the tides 6, blackrock caverns 5, halls of origination 1); uldum/ulduar/mount hyjal/stormstout/grim batol recorded as deliberate allows (WotLK-legitimate titan/raid/pre-Cata lore text) in tests/test_timeframes_era_flavors.py KEPT_ALLOWS_WOTLK. Round 2 close (card-lint): deepholm/firelands/mechagon/therazane/tiragarde sound/twilight highlands pruned to KEPT_ALLOWS_WOTLK - the shared corpus's vanilla-era cards (Gnome, Earth elemental, Therazane, Trogg, Boat, Molten Core, ...) cite them (the R5-1 rule). Round 6 (R6-3): timeless isle joined the ban list - the MoP zone hits the shipped WotLK dump 6 times (broadcast_text 75183) and was neither banned nor recorded; the same scan standard that caught the MoP title now catches the MoP zone. Its single card drop (the Southsea Freebooters card's MoP/DF retail narration) is a correct-era drop recorded in CARD_DROPS_RECORDED. fourth war/dragon isles/forbidden reach are deliberately RECORDED instead of banned (17/11/1 cards of era-legitimate content narrate them in retail-written passing - CARD_CONTENT_RECORDED); archaeology/obsidium/pyrium are the generic-word collision class, recorded in KEPT_ALLOWS_WOTLK.
